# Home {.unnumbered}

This is a **"port"** of Goodman et al's book [***Probabilistic Models of Cognition***](https://probmods.org/) into Quarto, with a few changes to help us integrate the material better with [**DSAN 5650: Causal Inference for Computational Social Science**](https://jjacobs.me/dsan5650) (e.g., allowing us to cross-reference code and figures, include PDFs of the readings, and auto-grade the end-of-chapter exercises!)

Use the sidebar to the left or the link at the bottom of this page to get started!
